title: Why You Refuse to Sleep When Exhausted

vo.en: You’re exhausted, but you won’t sleep.

visual.description: A close-up of a man's face looking extremely tired, rubbing his eyes in a dimly lit room.

vo.en: Instead, you stare at your screen, scrolling through mindless videos for hours.

visual.description: Close-up of hands holding a smartphone in the dark, thumb swiping rapidly.

vo.en: Psychologists call this Revenge Bedtime Procrastination, and it’s a cry for autonomy.

visual.description: A vintage mechanical clock with the hands spinning rapidly or an hourglass with sand falling fast.

vo.en: If your day felt like a series of obligations you didn't choose...

visual.description: A fast-paced montage of busy city life, crowded streets, and office buildings.

vo.en: your brain stays awake to reclaim the freedom you were denied.

visual.description: A man standing alone on a balcony at night, looking out at the peaceful city lights.

vo.en: It’s the only part of the day where you are finally the boss.

visual.description: A hand moving a chess piece strategically on a board in a decisive manner.

vo.en: You aren't lazy; you’re just trying to own your life again. Follow to spot your mental blindspots. After all...

visual.description: A side profile silhouette of a man thinking, with abstract light patterns in the background.
